source_text:
Title: Merehaven begins work on Harbor Loop safe-streets plan
Published: 2024-09-23

Merehaven's Street Design Office proposed the Harbor Loop Safe Streets Plan on 18 May 2023. The proposal would add protected cycle lanes and wider sidewalks along the Harbor Loop, a road corridor connecting the ferry district with the town center.

The office held a public consultation from 2 October through 12 November 2023. In response to feedback, it revised the design in February 2024 to retain loading access on two commercial blocks. Merehaven Council approved the revised plan on 8 March 2024.

Construction began on 9 September 2024, with work proceeding along the corridor in sections.
